Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Clean Grid Alliance                      ewheeler@cleangridalliance.org           intertranec@gmail.com                   
Clean Grid Alliance                                                               bsoholt@cleangridalliance.org           

Basis for Intervening:
Clean Grid Alliance is a Minnesota-based nonprofit organization working in the MISO footprint to advance clean, renewable energy, reduce carbon emissions, build the clean energy economy in the Midwest, and transition MISO market rules to accommodate robust amounts of low-and zero carbon generation. 

Members of Clean Grid Alliance include wind, solar, storage and transmission developers, data center developers, state/regional/national NGOs working in the public interest, and other businesses that provide goods and services to the renewable energy industries. Our members will be significantly impacted by the Commission's resolution of this filing. Clean Grid Alliance staff and consultants are deeply involved in the MISO stakeholder process on market and operational rules that govern the participation of renewable energy in the MISO marketplace. Clean Grid Alliance thus has an interest in this proceeding that cannot be represented by any other entity, and that supports its intervention in these proceedings.
